The blessings of fraternal unity.</title> <div sID="gen10813" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7048"/>1-2. As the fragrant oil is refreshing, so this affords delight. The holy anointing oil for the high priest was olive oil mixed with four of the best spices (<reference osisRef="Exod.30.22">Ex 30:22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Exod.25.30">25, 30</reference>). Its rich profusion typified the abundance of the Spirit's graces. As the copious dew, such as fell on Hermon, falls in fertilizing power on the mountains of Zion, so this unity is fruitful in good works. <div eID="gen10813" type="x-p"/>
